kudoke-1.title: KUDOKE · concrete pedestal
kudoke-1.observation: Read the first letter of GERMANY above six. It looks like a C before Lynx; the G is distinct in the finished frame. The larger KUDOKE plaque is readable in both.

kudoke-2.title: KUDOKE · folded aluminium
kudoke-2.observation: Look at the curved GERMANY inscription and the serifs on the KUDOKE plaque. The finished lettering has more distinct edges.

lang-1.title: Lang & Heyne · velvet still life
lang-1.observation: All three inscriptions are readable before Lynx. Move the divider across DRESDEN to compare the letter shapes and spacing.

lang-2.title: Lang & Heyne · theatre wristshot
lang-2.observation: The Y in HEYNE looks like a T before Lynx. The finished frame reads HEYNE, and the lettering on the MADE IN SAXONY arc is clearer.
